title: Mondrian Rhythmic Accents
prompt:
TrackType: Instrument. Solo acoustic vibraphone only, unaccompanied. Bright, crisp, short damped mallet notes in the upper-middle register. An active interlocking counter-rhythm: recurring offbeat eighth notes, quick two-to-four-note sixteenth-note clusters and displaced accents. Use C, E, G and A, with many small repeated cells distributed across every bar, roughly four to eight short attacks per bar with occasional faster bursts. Leave brief gaps between clusters, avoiding long silences and continuous ringing. A playful flickering pointillist pattern that adds detail above a boogie-woogie piano foundation. Short decay, restrained dynamics, no sustained chords, bass line, drum kit, piano, trumpet or strings.

120 BPM, 4/4, eight bars, exactly 16 seconds. A fixed C tonal center using C, E, G and A with occasional D passing notes, no chord progression or modulation. Inspired by the intricate small colored blocks and interlocking lines of Piet Mondrian's Victory Boogie Woogie. Steady underlying pulse and lightly swung phrasing, precise articulation, dry intimate acoustic recording. Begin immediately in the established groove on the first downbeat. Maintain consistent activity throughout. No intro, outro, fade, final cadence, dramatic build or vocals. A repeating instrumental part intended to be layered with other instruments.
